packageRules.description: The toolchain pinned in mise.toml is what CI runs, so keep it current in one PR.
Action digests are pinned by SHA; group them so one PR covers the workflows.

opencode's plugin types in package.json decide what this package compiles against, and the pinned opencode-ai in test/e2e/package.json is what the e2e test runs, so they move together and are reviewed on their own.
